definitions.entry: Unique event + capture/time + original line + price + score; model duplicates removed.
definitions.mixed_archive: Legacy recorded lines are kept separate; mixed all-recorded history is descriptive, not homogeneous provider-main validation.
definitions.first: Earliest qualifying exact-priced saved point per event, selected before outcomes; not best minute or price.
definitions.balanced: Every match has equal weight: mean of its saved point returns, then mean across matches.
definitions.without_top3: Remove the three highest first-entry net-return matches; recompute N.
definitions.without_best_day: Remove the Moscow entry day with greatest first-entry net profit.
definitions.validation: First complete 24 hours after reset when available. Discovery excludes the full validation window and boundary-crossing events.
definitions.multiple_testing: Fixed coarse families, singles/pairs and previously declared triples. All discovered pockets remain exploratory; no future profitability claim.
definitions.rough_fdr: BH on one-sided normal approximations of first-per-match returns in discovery; descriptive, dependence and post-selection limitations remain.
definitions.not_execution_proof: Saved API price is not verified executable bookmaker price.
